label: platereader_kinetic_test
description: Short integration test: 25 C, 30 s equilibration, A490 every 30 s for 3 min (7 reads).
gen5_protocol_notes: Enable incubation at 25 °C; Gen5 waits for setpoint before the first read when the IU incubator is installed.
Set read mode to kinetic (not endpoint-only).
Schedule 7 reads: initial, then every 30s until 180s kinetic time.
Hold at 25 °C for 30s after lid close before the first kinetic read (cold-start warm-up).
Score slope on kinetic times 60–180s (90–210s from plate close).

Robot control: platereader_run_kinetic_schedule triggers one saved Gen5 kinetic method — bake temperature, equilibration, and read cadence into that protocol (AutoGUI action Experiment_TEM1_Kinetic_A490).
